title: Record actual hosted Windows and fresh Linux qualification
objective: Qualify the reviewed CI configuration using real runs of the committed source revision.
acceptance: Record run URLs, exact source revision, host/target/tool versions and per-job conclusions for Windows full and all five Linux stages.
Verify public fork versus trusted-source runner gating from actual workflow configuration and executed event context.
Report unavailable runners, authentication, divergence or failures honestly with actor/action evidence; never infer Linux success from configuration.
Use only sanitized results; keep raw logs, stores, caches and build output untracked and retain Q001 packaging gate.
non_goals: Modifying workflows or product code in this evidence-only slice; hiding failed jobs or changing runner policy.
